title: Chapter 327: Besieging The Thunder Skeleton King
content:
Chapter 327: Besieging The Thunder Skeleton King

At the moment, only Gong Zheng can barely block a few swords.

During this period of time, Wang Shuo also accumulated a lot of water of life.

He gave three drops to each of his favorite generals, which was equivalent to three extra lives.

"Gong Zheng, enter."

Wang Shuo, Ayub and others also rushed forward.

"Another group of people are here to die! Jie Jie Jie Jie..."

The Thunder Skeleton King has no clothes on his body, and is dressed in a dry skeleton, as crystal clear as jade.

If he had facial expressions, at this time, he should stick out his tongue, lick the corners of his mouth, and then show a wicked smile, but unfortunately he has no face and no tongue.

Hearing the hoarse strange laughter, Wang Shuo felt creepy.

The Weeping Blood Spear was blocked by the Thunder Saber, and the huge force directly knocked Wang Shuo back several steps.

The gap in strength is so huge!

Wang Shuo was shocked.

After Wang Shuo was repulsed, Gong Zheng immediately raised his shield on top. He did not dare to be careless. The petrified skin instantly covered his whole body, and his body suddenly rose to three meters high.

Even so, the Thunder Skeleton King was only one arm shorter than him. The Thunder Skeleton King struck Gong Zheng's petrified skin, leaving a gash 3 centimeters deep.

Wang Shuo was shocked. This was the first time that someone could leave obvious wounds on Gong Zheng's body.

Gong Zheng also cried out in pain.

He immediately blocked the shield in front of him, not daring to use his petrified skin to withstand the Thunder Skeleton King's attack.

"Use your ultimate move." With a loud shout, Wang Shuo immediately used his control skills.

Goode also immediately used his control skills.

Before amplifying the move, use control skills. This is standard. If you go short, you will suffer a big loss.

"Bound with iron ropes", "Tangled with roots".

In order to be sure, the two of them released their control skills at the same time. After all, the other party was a warrior, two levels higher.

The two skills trapped Thunder Skeleton King for 1 second.

"Now."

"A blow that turns into a dragon"

"Lightning Dragon Strike"

"Double Arrows of Ice and Fire"

"Three hits"

"Ice Jue Slash"

…

All the generals released their ultimate moves.

There is no way, the defense is as high as 1800 points, it is not a ultimate move, it cannot be hit at all.

The ultimate moves launched by 15 high-level generals are very effective.

"-1200"

"-1500"

"-200"

"-780"

…

A series of numbers appeared from the head of the Thunder Skeleton King.

"Ah...ah..."

He roared angrily, and black death energy surged around him, with countless purple thunders shining on the bones of his body.

"Very well, you ants succeeded in irritating me."

"Thunder"

I saw him inserting the thunder sword on the ground, bending his elbows slightly, making fists with his hands, and a burst of momentum exploded. Thunder overflowed all around, breaking free from the restraints, and at the same time shaking the surrounding senior generals away more than ten meters.

Some of the generals who were nearby were shocked so hard that their mouths were filled with blood, and their health points dropped by thousands.

Wang Shuo also felt uncomfortable. He was knocked directly to the wall of the city gate tower, and his mouth felt sweet.

He held back the blood rising in his mouth, calmed down for a moment, and then swallowed it back.

"Jiejie, are you the only ones with skills? Try mine!"

After saying that, the thunder sword on the ground shook slightly, and then flew back to his hand, and the thunder on his body gathered on the long sword.

"Red Thunder Slash"

The target of the attack was clearly Ayub.

Among the generals present, Ayub seemed to be the most powerful in terms of image.

Ayub has a tall figure and a stern face. He holds a green dragon sword and is powerful and domineering.

Compared to Wang Shuo and Ye Tianba, he attracts more hatred.

As for Gong Zheng, he was directly ignored because he only had defense and his attack power was almost negligible. His attacks could not break the Thunder Skeleton King's defense at all.
